contamination_notes: IBBI order is from May 2019 and describes insolvency proceedings well after the decision date of July 2012. Indian Kanoon and Casemine records describe later legal proceedings. These must be used only for outcome verification. Input.json uses only the debenture default stress facts available at 26 July 2012.

Indian Kanoon records describe later legal proceedings beyond decision date
Casemine records cover later legal judgment stages
Internal company financial records and debenture trust documents from 2012 not fully publicly accessible
